scope: Every card has a reviewed display name and at least one playable-deck reference. Remaining inherited names, joined labels, and damaged prose are migrated; unused Actions, Allies, Objects, Spells and other cards receive explicit thematic assignments. Fixed nation alignments and human-only Roadside Mischief are preserved. IDs, individual numeric rules and art references stay stable.

50065.quote: A little warmth, a little courage. We can still give each other those.

50111.quote: I have walked a long way to learn what these woods remember.

50129.quote: Let others promise another dawn. I will rule the world that remains.

20030.quote: Every school of magic has something to teach, if you can set your pride aside.

20139.quote: The colours shift as each new spell is woven into the cloth.

40042.quote: The Golden Mound rises above Goldenwood, where the fallen are remembered beneath living branches.

40062.quote: Blackwold remembers every axe raised against it. Its roots hold fast.

40088.quote: Sandfort keeps its gates shut against the noon heat and opens them to the evening caravans.

40160.quote: Stonehall rings with hammer blows by day and quiet songs by night.

40163.quote: Amber Isle stands above the eastern sea, a last landmark before open water.

40164.quote: Moorfarm keeps a harvest behind its fences and a watchman at the gate.

20153.quote: The first age left few answers, but its stories still teach us what to ask.

20213.quote: With the doors barred and the lane watched, the village can sleep for another night.

110050.description: Fragments of an ancient royal sword, kept through generations in the hope that a worthy heir would forge it anew.

avatars.title: Dawn Rally
avatars.theme: Orren Dawnbringer leads the Halflings and their allies. Protect village homes, rally Halfling archers and slingers, and use small-folk courage, hidden paths, recovery, and unexpected aid to overcome stronger enemies.

avatars.title: Elven Wisdom
avatars.theme: An elven leader gathers scholars and scouts. Use wards, hidden knowledge, precise spells, and information to prepare before committing.

avatars.title: Border Kingdoms
avatars.theme: A human king unites threatened towns and riders. Strengthen defences, steady morale, protect roads, and prepare the frontier for war.

avatars.title: Roadside Mischief
avatars.theme: Mat Heatherthorn leads human townsfolk, adventurers, and rangers along the northern roads. Gather rumours, hide movement, steal supplies, and disrupt stronger enemies with practical tricks. This deck is human-based, including the human Firstblood rangers; it contains no Halflings or nonhuman units.

avatars.title: Mountain Halls
avatars.theme: A dwarf lord leads the mountain holds. Build a sturdy economy, recover treasure, equip allies, and defend the halls through a long struggle.

avatars.title: Tower Council
avatars.theme: A Celestial councillor directs Thornspire through persuasion, knowledge, and carefully timed magic. Control choices and hold influence over independent realms.

avatars.title: Arcane Studies
avatars.theme: An independent Celestial scholar brings distant magical traditions to the council. Combine spells, enhancements, and weakening effects to reshape the battlefield.

avatars.title: Ironworks
avatars.theme: An Orc commander turns Thornspire industry into military strength. Use furnaces, siege tools, disciplined infantry, and sustained production to maintain pressure.

avatars.title: Village Tyrants
avatars.theme: Bill Thistlewood runs an independent human protection racket within the neutral Tower Council. Hired thugs, informants, intimidation, and a pipe-weed monopoly control civilian settlements. Ruthless self-interest defines this deck; it does not serve the Shadow Dominion.

avatars.title: Watchful Shadow
avatars.theme: A watchful aspect of the Celestial Nharok commands spies and cursed riders. Reveal movement, spread fear, and restrict enemy options.

avatars.title: False Gifts
avatars.theme: Nharok in a persuasive guise offers knowledge and gifts with hidden costs. Corrupt trust, steal secrets, and turn enemy loyalties before open conquest.

avatars.title: Haunted Wood
avatars.theme: A Wraithlord commands Blackwood Keep. Use spirits, spiders, cursed creatures, dark sorcery, and lingering effects to wear resistance down.

avatars.title: Eastern Warbands
avatars.theme: A mortal eastern warlord gathers riders and warbands. Use diplomacy, threats, and emissary pressure to raise forces and drive them west.

avatars.title: Frozen Throne
avatars.theme: A Wraithlord rules Grimhold from Frostkeep. Combine northern Orcs and Trolls with terror, deception, and sorcery to break the border kingdoms.

orren_the_kindled.reason: Bring the Halfling characters, troops, villages and support from Roadside Mischief into Orren Dawnbringer's deck.

orren_greycloack.reason: Human-only units led by Mat Heatherthorn; remove Halfling village content and nonhuman units/support, add human townsfolk and practical tricks. Firstbloods are humans of the old blood.
